mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.id, m.parent_id, m.menu_type, m.menu_name, m.menu_path, m.menu_icon, m.perm_code, m.is_visible, m.is_cache, m.sort_order, m.create_time, m.update_time FROM menu m WHERE m.is_deleted = 0 AND m.id IN ( -- 用户角色直接分配的菜单 SELECT rm.menu_id FROM role_menu rm JOIN user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rm.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} UNION -- 上述菜单的父菜单（确保目录结构完整） SELECT DISTINCT m2.parent_id FROM menu m2 WHERE m2.id IN ( SELECT rm2.menu_id FROM role_menu rm2 JOIN user_role ur2 ON ur2.role_id = rm2.role_id WHERE ur2.user_id = #{userId} ) AND m2.parent_id IS NOT NULL AND m2.parent_id != 0 ) ORDER BY m.parent_id ASC, m.sort_order ASC

SELECT id, parent_id, menu_type, menu_name, menu_path, menu_icon, perm_code, is_visible, is_cache, sort_order, create_time, update_time FROM menu WHERE is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY parent_id ASC, sort_order ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO menu (parent_id, menu_type, menu_name, menu_path, menu_icon, perm_code, is_visible, is_cache, sort_order, create_time) VALUES (#{parentId}, #{menuType}, #{menuName}, #{menuPath}, #{menuIcon}, #{permCode}, #{isVisible}, #{isCache}, #{sortOrder}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE menu SET parent_id = #{parentId}, menu_type = #{menuType}, menu_name = #{menuName}, menu_path = #{menuPath}, menu_icon = #{menuIcon}, perm_code = #{permCode}, is_visible = #{isVisible}, is_cache = #{isCache}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE menu SET is_deleted = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM menu WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO role_permission (role_id, perm_id, create_time) SELECT 1, p.id, NOW() FROM permission p WHERE p.perm_code = #{permCode}
INSERT IGNORE INTO role_menu (role_id, menu_id, create_time) VALUES (1, #{menuId}, NOW())
